hook.name: AeonStrategyHook
hook.description: Fee collection hook that takes up to 10% on swaps (50% for the first 2 minutes after launch) via afterSwapReturnsDelta, converting non-ETH fees to ETH via a nested pool swap and distributing proceeds 80% to a strategy contract and 20% to a configurable marketing wallet. Pool initialization and liquidity addition are gated to a designated Strategy contract.
